correctness.rationale: The characteristic hypothesis makes the line factors, singular supports and branches split over a finite separable cyclotomic extension. The line families are separately defined, and the cross-family points are exactly (uv:v:1) with one branch from each family. Passing from local normalization units to branch residues gives (G_m^m)/G_m at an m-branch point; the kernel has a filtration by additive groups coming from truncated principal units. The normalization has zero connected Picard variety. Dividing the product of branch-residue tori by the component scalars, with diagonal kernel by connectedness, gives the torus quotient. Taking characters makes the map the integral oriented incidence boundary; its kernel is H_1, not a rational cycle space. The coordinate stars plus the one A-branch per triple point form three trees. The two additional branches at (1,1) join them, Galois-equivariantly. Restriction to the chord coefficients is an integral isomorphism on cycles (unique signed return path in the tree), and gives two unsigned copies of the nonidentity root-pair set. This works unchanged in small characteristic and over imperfect fields. Frobenius fixed-pair counts, orbit inversion, Weil restriction and the two numerical examples follow. The stated dimensions agree with the arithmetic genus minus the cycle rank. In the point count, the normalization contributes 3s(q^r+1), and gluing replaces 3s+3s^2 rational branches by 3+s^2 rational singularities, with s=gcd(n,q^r-1).
residual_risks: Finite recorded tests are corroboration only; no claim about the entire unipotent factor as a vector group or about characteristic dividing n.

value.rationale: For a standard arrangement, the exact Galois lattice determines the k-isomorphism class and the finite groups of torus points, which rational zeta data cannot generally identify. Uniformly extending from split/inversion to all orbit lengths, even degree and small admissible characteristic solves a natural arithmetic classification problem. The equivariant fundamental cycles exhibit the mechanism directly; the known point counts are not the value claim.
residual_risks: This is about a specific untwisted divisor family and its torus quotient, not a general classification of Picard groups of line arrangements.
